features: Glassy Outlook: Enhance your workspace with this transparent mouse featuring vibrant RGB lighting for a vivid, aesthetic touch.
Dual mode: The mouse can provide an immaculate dual connection of 2.4GHz and BT so you can work without interruption.
1600 DPI: The mouse comes with a 3-level DPI and an advanced optical sensor up to 1600 DPI for smooth cursor movements with reliably utmost precision.
USB dongle: One of the essential elements in the mouse is a USB nano receiver for a plug-and-play function.
Buttons: This mouse is compactly built with 5 buttons- the DPI control button, a dedicated desktop button,the right & left click, and the middle scroll.
